fields.label: Group
fields.description: Machine = shown as dropdown. Specification, Finishing and Outsource = shown as checkboxes. Outsource specs get their own section in the cost breakdown.

fields.label: Parent Spec
fields.description: Optional. If set, this spec is a child shown under its parent in the calculator; selecting the parent auto-selects this child.

fields.label: Auto Select in Calculator
fields.description: Auto-tick this spec for the calculation (top-level: on load; child: when its parent is selected). Cascades to its own children.

fields.label: Pricing Type
fields.description: Offset = only shown in Offset calculator. Flexo = only shown in Flexo calculator. Both = shown in both (e.g. Delivery, Proof Board, Corrugated Boxes).

fields.label: Adds Colors
fields.description: Selecting this spec increases the effective No of Colors by this amount (e.g. Gold Color = 1). Drives the Flexo printing formula and plate count. Leave 0 for none.

fields.label: Allow Foil Assignment (Flexo)
fields.description: When ticked, this spec shows a foil picker (COLD/HOT + %) in the calculator and produces its own foil cost line. Set Parent Spec = Print to nest it under printing. Foils are no longer assigned on the machine.

fields.label: Skip Machine If Spec Selected
fields.description: If this spec is also selected, skip the machine cost for the current spec.

fields.label: Skip Machine If This Machine Used
fields.description: In the calculator a 'Skip machine cost' checkbox auto-ticks when this machine is running on any selected spec. Untick it to charge this spec's machine anyway.

fields.label: Skip Machine If Printing Runs
fields.description: If any selected spec is using a printing machine, the 'Skip machine cost' checkbox auto-ticks (inline with printing). Untick it to charge this spec's machine anyway.

fields.label: Machine Qty Units
fields.options:
Full sheet
Cut sheet
Sqinch
Pcs
Impressions

fields.label: Ink Filter
fields.description: If inks are listed here, only those inks will appear in the Production Assignment dialog for this spec. Leave empty to show all inks.

fields.label: Allowed Inks
fields.description: Leave empty to show all active inks. Populate to restrict ink selection for this spec.

fields.label: Manufacturing / BOM
fields.description: Controls how this specification appears in the BOM Builder.

fields.label: Include in BOM Chain
fields.description: Uncheck to exclude this spec from BOM chain by default (e.g. Proof Board, samples).

fields.label: ERPNext Operation
fields.description: Default ERPNext Operation used in BOM. Can be overridden in BOM Builder.

fields.label: Quality Inspection Template
fields.description: If set, QI will be required on the output SFG of this operation.
